harness.whatItDid: Given a domain and a one-line goal, ran 25 operations against at least 19 organizations, with access or data taken at 10. Gambit counted 105 attack projects launched between 10 and 15 September and at least 27 companies compromised; NorForge found 20+ exposed panels and confirmed a live uploader web shell at a hardware-parts vendor. Google separately saw it used against a US aerospace target.

uses.quote: The attackers seeded each task with an organization's root domain, allowing the framework to autonomously enumerate the attack surface.
Our investigation shows that Cairn confirmed unauthorized access or data retrieval at 10 targeted organizations.
The framework logged access to more than one million member records, roughly 31,000 CRM contacts and staff password hashes.
